ProjectProfile.Name: DevCraft
ProjectProfile.Purpose: Build DevCraft into a full SpecKit replacement and standalone repository for documentation-first software delivery.
ProjectProfile.Description: DevCraft is an AI-driven SDLC CLI and documentation-first workflow system for managing project discovery, feature work, implementation evidence, and reusable DevCraft guidance.

Features.Name: CLI Logo And Tagline
Features.ShortDescription: Create the first DevCraft CLI branding feature: a polished ASCII-art DevCraft logo with designed by Johnny DevCraft beneath it.

Features.Name: Startup Soul And Folder Scan
Features.ShortDescription: Create soul setup, inspect the current working folder, and report detected projects and AI-driven SDLC status.

Features.Name: Recommend DevCraft For Unmanaged Folder
Features.ShortDescription: Install DevCraft as the workflow for a scanned project folder when no AI-driven SDLC workflow is detected.

Features.Name: Situational Awareness Logs
Features.ShortDescription: Maintain structured situational awareness logs and compress them into higher-level summaries over time.

Features.Name: Beta 11 Repository Upgrade Agent
Features.ShortDescription: Upgrade existing repository DevCraft installations, record the installed version, and migrate older feature storage into the current layout.

Features.Name: Updates to the Instructions.txt
Features.ShortDescription: Give desktop agents the full DevCraft startup context: soul first, situational awareness, and DevCraft rules dormant until Activate DevCraft.

Features.Name: Fix System Central Projects, and Features Mappings
Features.ShortDescription: Persist System Central features to the profile projects.json so the project's feature list exists in both the repository configure.json and the central index.

Features.Name: Enable Feature Rename
Features.ShortDescription: Add a per-feature action menu to List Features: edit the feature name in both indexes, open the feature directory in Visual Studio Code, or start a conversation about the feature.

Features.Name: Issues running on Windows
Features.ShortDescription: Fix Windows installation and confirmed Windows runtime defects: install.ps1 fails under iex on Windows PowerShell 5.1 with a null path error.

Features.Name: Fix Editing, and Default Values
Features.ShortDescription: Every edit pre-fills the existing value so the operator changes it instead of retyping it, and the project-name prompt accepts the shown default (the current folder name) on Enter.

Features.Name: Starting prompt
Features.ShortDescription: Prompt the operator for an opening prompt in a long-text window before AI client selection on every agent handoff, and append it as the final section of the generated prompt (beta 18).
